challenge.better_approach: Considered: (1) the build commit's git file list: measured, 68f5 anchors right only on its .py subset, which would be picking the input to pass; (2) skip-red off-box: refused by the orchestrator (a skip is a hollow green); (3) ship berths into class-space: berths are instance-space by design (Law 5, skill_block). The measured fixture is the smallest honest input.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the two berths' writes_to are immutable (they are historical berths; the live-equality check reds if one moves).
challenge.prior_art: hollow.writes_to docstring (berth derived from the berths, never read off the ticket, 2026-09-10) — unchanged for the gate; only the historical tooth pins its input. memory: inherited numbers need an address — the fixture names its berth and date.
challenge.real_collision: hollow.writes_to's rule that a gate may not read evidence the judged thing supplies: not a collision; the fixture feeds a proof about build_anchor, not a gate's reading.

answers.falsifier: RED if the tooth reds on a box without the berths while the anchors are right; or if a berth's live writes_to differs from the fixture and the tooth stays green.
answers.how: In cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow_anchors_before_the_build_that_stands.py, a _BERTH_WRITES_TO dict holds the two lists the orchestrator read with hollow.writes_to on akiendelllinux 2026-11-13; the tooth feeds them to build_anchor; where hollow.writes_to answers (the berth is on this box) it must equal the fixture, and HollowUnmeasurable leaves the fixture standing in.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (a measurement recorded in a shape that can be wrong beats one re-read from a box that may not have it) and Law 5 (the berth is instance-space; what the class-space proof needs lives in class-space).
answers.what: The live-anchor tooth for 68f563403c8f and c691e19d5464 reads each ticket's decompose writes_to from a measured fixture naming its berth and date, so it measures the anchor on every box, and checks the live berth still equals the fixture wherever the berth exists.

bullets.text: A live-repo tooth over instance-space berths seals green only on the charting box; the class is the same as the far-bus red found the same day.
